history.summary: A 2015 freehold 'oversized 2BR' at Uber 388 (D16), 1,314 sqft at $2.28M / $1,735 psf, 520m from the new Bayshore TEL MRT. PSF reads ~6% below the $1,843 median but only because 1,314 sqft is enormous for a 2BR — the real signal is a $2.28M quantum for a 2BR, a tough exit. Freehold and a new TEL station nearby are genuine positives, netting to a fair hold.
history.rating_rationale: Below-median PSF ($1,735 vs $1,843) is an oversized-unit artefact — $2.28M is a very high quantum for a 2BR, well above the segment's natural buyer pool. Appreciation 6.3%/yr is unreliable (only 17 txn). Offsetting: freehold tenure, and 520m to the new Bayshore TE29 (TEL) station within the Bayshore precinct transformation. Even arena record (197-216) and middling score 557.
red_flags: $2.28M quantum is very high for a 2BR — narrow buyer pool, hard exit
Below-median PSF is driven by the oversized 1,314 sqft, not true value
catalysts: 520m to new Bayshore TE29 (Thomson-East Coast Line) MRT
Freehold tenure in the transforming D16 Bayshore precinct
Below district-median PSF and a spacious dual-key-capable layout
